column1: # Pinned manifest for the Python wheels vendored INTO THIS REPOSITORY.
# Everything else the engine runtime needs is resolved from an index at build
# time (scripts/python-requirements.txt, hash-pinned). A package lands here
# instead when the build must keep working after the index stops carrying it:
# the artifact bytes are committed, and this manifest is their integrity
# record. scripts/install-vendored-wheels.ps1 installs the `wheel` rows with
# --no-index, so no build step contacts an index for them.
# ROLES
#  wheel  the binary artifact actually installed into an interpreter
#  sdist  the same release's source distribution, committed so a fork is
#         possible without the index. Every `wheel` row REQUIRES a matching
#         `sdist` row at the same version; the install script refuses
#         otherwise, because an artifact that cannot be rebuilt is not owned.
# Files live in vendor/wheels/. Bumping a row means replacing the files,
# recomputing the sha256 (certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256), and reviewing the
# result as a git diff. Nothing here is ever re-fetched at build time.
# spdx is the DECLARED license of the distribution itself. Binary wheels that
# bundle native libraries carry their own additional terms; those are notice
# rows in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md, keyed to the measured library versions and
# never to the wheel's own bundled-license file, which upstream lets go stale.
package
pi_heif
pi_heif
